async def act(page):
    # Step 1: Navigate to the homepage by clicking the 'Epoch & Drift Benchmark' link
    homepage_link = page.get_by_role("link", name="Epoch & Drift Benchmark", exact=True)
    await homepage_link.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("load")
    await asyncio.sleep(2)  # Additional wait to ensure content loads

    # Step 2: Search for the 'JavaScript SpeechSynthesis API' post on the homepage
    # Look for any link or element containing the keyword
    target_link = page.get_by_role("link", name="JavaScript SpeechSynthesis API", exact=False)
    if await target_link.count() > 0:
        await target_link.first.click()
        await page.wait_for_load_state("load")
        await asyncio.sleep(2)
    else:
        # If no direct link, check for articles or content that might contain it
        articles = page.get_by_role("article")
        for i in range(await articles.count()):
            article = articles.nth(i)
            header = article.get_by_role("header")
            if await header.count() > 0:
                header_text = await header.text_content()
                if "JavaScript SpeechSynthesis API" in header_text:
                    link_in_article = article.get_by_role("link").first
                    await link_in_article.click()
                    await page.wait_for_load_state("load")
                    await asyncio.sleep(2)
                    break
        else:
            return "Could not find 'JavaScript SpeechSynthesis API' post on the homepage."

    # Step 3: Get the current page URL after navigation
    page_url = page.url
    # Extract relative URL if needed (assuming base URL is http://localhost:8000)
    if page_url.startswith("http://localhost:8000"):
        page_url = page_url.replace("http://localhost:8000", "")
    if page_url == "":
        page_url = "/"

    # Step 4: Submit the comment using the knowledge_base function
    comment_text = 'Thanks, this solved my problem.'
    commenter_name = 'Anonymous User'
    commenter_email = 'user@example.com'
    commenter_website = ''
    save_details = True

    result_message = await submit_comment_on_page(
        page,
        page_url,
        comment_text,
        commenter_name,
        commenter_email,
        commenter_website,
        save_details
    )
    return result_message
